description: Screen one transaction by hash: what moved, who took part, a label and AML risk for every participant, and an overall verdict. Pass focus_address (e.g. your own deposit address) to get the verdict from that wallet's point of view. Read-only.

block_number.description: Optional. Looked up automatically on ethereum and bsc.

chain.description: Blockchain: bitcoin, ethereum, bsc or tron.

focus_address.description: Optional. The wallet you are screening for, to scope the verdict to it.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash (0x-prefixed on EVM chains, bare hex txid on bitcoin).

name: screen_transaction
title: Screen a transaction
